CA.rationale: No attention/allocation condition explicitly linked to an identified content's organization/access.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an organization-related origin field, and a separate status/metadata are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the organization/presentation/access of a named content.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with attributes (red/blue coordinate sets) are listed.

D.rationale: Content coordinates and a separate origin/status field are both present for the same referent, distinguishing content identification from provenance/organization.

O.rationale: The report states how spatial coordinates map to rows/columns and provides origin/organization metadata for specific referents.
